authorization: 只读已有800对validation B/C轨迹，比较共同前20步、close/open时机及公开状态变化；held-out、qualification封存。

definitions.pairing: same task, same training seed, same official global initial index; left=B, right=C
definitions.open_after_close: first action[6]<0 strictly after first close; initial open is not a release
definitions.events: command events only, not evidence of grasp/release/transport or target proximity
definitions.censoring: no fill after terminal; missing event remains None; compare censored event order with observed horizons
definitions.common_prefix: min(20, B observed steps, C observed steps); full20 statistics only if both complete20
definitions.state_alignment: trace0 is post-stabilization reset; action[k] uses public trace[k-1] and produces trace[k]
definitions.state_metrics: pairwise state distance and each-arm displacement/path from reset are separate; neither is target error
definitions.difference_threshold: exact saved numeric inequality; no tuned epsilon; report magnitudes separately
definitions.winner_orientation: only discordant pairs, descriptive winner-minus-loser signs; both-success/failure retained as controls
definitions.aggregation: task x seed x outcome plus task/outcome, equal-seed summaries among observed strata with n; no iid episode claims
definitions.no_selection: all20 seeds/all800 pairs, no checkpoint selection, significance, fitted predictor, training modification or causal claim
